title: Merge duplicate LearningProgramRepository test suites (learning_program_repository_test.dart + learning_program_service_test.dart)
rule: Fowler duplication lens + TQ-1 (pyramid/test-suite hygiene, avoid redundant suites)

evidence.quote: test('programs have sequential ids starting at 1', () {
test('program ids are sequential starting from 1', () {

why: Both files exist purely to test LearningProgramRepository (a ~60-line class) via LearningProgramRepository.instance, and both independently cover getAllPrograms, getActivePrograms, getProgramById (valid/0/out-of-range), getProgramByName (found/missing) and getProgramsByCurriculumType/getActiveProgramsByCurriculumType with near-identical assertions restated in different words. 329 combined lines maintain one class's coverage in two places that can silently drift — one file hardcodes 'daf_yomi'/'bavli' fixture literals the other lacks — and a reviewer who finds only one of the two would reasonably (and wrongly) believe it is the sole coverage. This is the concrete cost the AG-5 mispathing finding predicted: because neither test sits at the discoverable mirrored path, whoever wrote the second file evidently didn't find the first.
recommendation: Merge into a single file at the mirrored path test/features/scheduler/domain/services/learning_program_service_test.dart, keeping the union of unique cases (the daf_yomi/bavli literal checks, testConfig/displayName field checks) and dropping exact duplicates.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one test file covers LearningProgramRepository, at the mirrored path
flutter test green; no unique assertion from either original file is lost
